test_projection_simplex: test the projection_simplex function to project vectors onto a simplex with a given scale
test_projection_ball: test the projection_l1_ball, projection_l2_ball, and projection_linf_ball functions for arrays, 2d arrays, and pytrees
test_projection_non_negative: test the projection_non_negative function to clamp negative values to zero across arrays and pytrees
test_projection_box: test the projection_box function to clamp values within lower and upper bounds using scalars, arrays, or pytrees
test_projection_simplex_jacobian: test the jacobian of projection_simplex using jax.jacrev, jax.jacfwd, finite differences, and vector-Jacobian products
